cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

#
# This file is generated only once,
# and is not re-generated if converter is called multiple times.
#
# User is free to modify the file as much as necessary
#

# Setup compiler settings
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)
# gnu++20: matches the Nx_WebServer draft's CUBE_CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS (-std=gnu++20), needed
# for app.cpp (structured bindings, std::unique_ptr/vector usage throughout).
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS ON)


# Define the build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

# Set the project name
set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME firmware_factory_control_unit)

# Enable compile command to ease indexing with e.g. clangd
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

# Core project settings
project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})
message("Build type: " ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})

# Enable CMake support for ASM, C and C++ languages
enable_language(C CXX ASM)

# Create an executable object type
add_executable(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

# Add STM32CubeMX generated sources
add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)

# STM32H5 / STM32H5xx: family macros that the shared stm32_libs (common_stm32/tmc2209/
# usb_pd, see the add_subdirectory() calls below) branch on, in addition to the
# chip-specific STM32H563xx that CubeMX's own MX_Defines_Syms already defines
# (cmake/stm32cubemx/CMakeLists.txt) -- added here instead of there since that file is
# regenerated by CubeMX on every "Generate Code" and would silently drop this again.
target_compile_definitions(stm32cubemx INTERFACE STM32H5 STM32H5xx)

# Link directories setup
target_link_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined library search paths
)

# ThreadX/FileX/NetXDuo (vendored under libs/ST/{threadx,filex,netxduo}, renamed from
# "Middlewares" to "libs" so STM32CubeMX's regeneration doesn't treat/delete it as its
# own middleware output -- see Nx_WebServer, the draft this was transferred from, for
# the original layout). Explicit per-component GLOBs instead of one recursive glob over
# all of libs/ST: each package ships several port/toolchain variants and only the
# cortex_m33/gnu ones (already the only ones vendored here) should be compiled.
file(GLOB THREADX_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/threadx/common/src/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/threadx/ports/cortex_m33/gnu/src/*.S
)
file(GLOB FILEX_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/filex/common/src/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/filex/common/drivers/*.c
)
file(GLOB NETXDUO_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/netxduo/common/src/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/netxduo/common/drivers/ethernet/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/netxduo/common/drivers/ethernet/lan8742/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/netxduo/addons/dhcp/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/netxduo/addons/mdns/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/netxduo/addons/web/*.c
)
# NetX Secure (TLS) + Crypto -- wegen der Dateimenge (~360 Dateien) per GLOB statt
# Hand-Liste eingebunden (identisches Muster wie in Nx_WebServer/CMakeLists.txt).
file(GLOB_RECURSE NX_SECURE_SOURCES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/netxduo/nx_secure/src/*.c
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libs/ST/netxduo/crypto_libraries/src/*.c
)

# Add sources to executable
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user sources here
    Core/Src/app.cpp
    Core/Src/fx_stm32_sd_driver_adapter.c
    Core/Src/malloc_lock.c
    Core/Src/tx_initialize_low_level.S
    Core/Src/generated/modbus_ui_page.c
    Core/Src/generated/device_certificate.c
    Drivers/BSP/Components/lan8742/lan8742.c
    ${THREADX_SOURCES}
    ${FILEX_SOURCES}
    ${NETXDUO_SOURCES}
    ${NX_SECURE_SOURCES}
)

# Add include paths
target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined include paths
    Core/Src
    libs/ST/threadx/common/inc
    libs/ST/threadx/ports/cortex_m33/gnu/inc
    libs/ST/filex/common/inc
    libs/ST/filex/common/drivers
    libs/ST/filex/ports/generic/inc
    libs/ST/netxduo/common/inc
    libs/ST/netxduo/ports/cortex_m33/gnu/inc
    libs/ST/netxduo/common/drivers/ethernet
    libs/ST/netxduo/common/drivers/ethernet/lan8742
    libs/ST/netxduo/addons/dhcp
    libs/ST/netxduo/addons/mdns
    libs/ST/netxduo/addons/web
    libs/ST/netxduo/nx_secure/inc
    libs/ST/netxduo/nx_secure/ports
    libs/ST/netxduo/crypto_libraries/inc
    libs/ST/netxduo/crypto_libraries/ports/cortex_m4/gnu/inc
    Drivers/BSP/Components/lan8742
)

# Add project symbols (macros)
target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined symbols
    # *_INCLUDE_USER_DEFINE_FILE: pulls in Core/Inc/{tx,nx,fx}_user.h (pool sizes/tick
    # rate/etc.), without these ThreadX/NetXDuo/FileX silently fall back to their
    # built-in defaults instead.
    FX_INCLUDE_USER_DEFINE_FILE
    NX_INCLUDE_USER_DEFINE_FILE
    TX_INCLUDE_USER_DEFINE_FILE
    # TrustZone: this core runs the CORTEX_M33_NS (non-secure) image only, no
    # Secure/Non-secure ThreadX handoff -- matches Nx_WebServer's build (STM32H573I-DK
    # is TrustZone-disabled there for the same reason).
    TX_SINGLE_MODE_NON_SECURE=1
    NX_SECURE_INCLUDE_USER_DEFINE_FILE
    NX_WEB_HTTPS_ENABLE
    NX_SECURE_ENABLE_ECC_CIPHERSUITE
    NX_SECURE_ENABLE_AEAD_CIPHER
)

# -fno-use-cxa-atexit: avoids pulling in __cxa_atexit/__dso_handle for global C++
# destructor registration (never runs on this target, matches Nx_WebServer's CXX flags).
target_compile_options(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-use-cxa-atexit>
)

# Remove wrong libob.a library dependency when using cpp files
list(REMOVE_ITEM CMAKE_C_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES ob)

# --- stm32_libs (common_stm32/tmc2209/usb_pd) integration ---
# Out-of-tree add_subdirectory() needs an explicit binary dir. These libraries link
# PUBLIC against a target named "stm32cubemx" for their HAL/CMSIS include dirs and
# compile flags/defines -- already provided as an INTERFACE target by
# cmake/stm32cubemx/CMakeLists.txt (extended with STM32H5/STM32H5xx above).
add_subdirectory(../stm32_libs/common_stm32 ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/stm32_libs/common_stm32)
add_subdirectory(../stm32_libs/tmc2209 ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/stm32_libs/tmc2209)
add_subdirectory(../stm32_libs/usb_pd ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/stm32_libs/usb_pd)

# Add linked libraries
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    stm32cubemx
    common_stm32
    tmc2209
    usb_pd

    # Add user defined libraries
)
